steps.name: fix-room-layout-reset
steps.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('web/src/pages/chamber-3d-page.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
replacements = [
    ('const DEFAULT_POT_COUNT: FeltPotCount = 1\n\nconst DEFAULT_POT_KEY', 'const DEFAULT_POT_COUNT: FeltPotCount = 1\nconst DEFAULT_ROOM_LAYOUT: RoomLayout = \"flat\"\n\nconst DEFAULT_POT_KEY'),
    ('useState<RoomLayout>(\"flat\")', 'useState<RoomLayout>(DEFAULT_ROOM_LAYOUT)'),
    ('setFanPosition(DEFAULT_FAN_POSITION)\n                      setWallHeightCm(DEFAULT_WALL_HEIGHT_CM)', 'setFanPosition(DEFAULT_FAN_POSITION)\n                      setRoomLayout(DEFAULT_ROOM_LAYOUT)\n                      setWallHeightCm(DEFAULT_WALL_HEIGHT_CM)'),
]
for old, new in replacements:
    if old not in s:
        raise SystemExit(f'missing expected source fragment: {old!r}')
    s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
